summary: Bearer may wear one additional Enchantment; Evolution does not count towards the Enchantment limit and stacks with Attuned, Essence Graft or Phoenix Tears.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: May wear one additional Enchantment. Scout gets it as a Trait at 1st level (permanent).

properties.note: Evolution does not count towards the bearer's Enchantment limit.

references.name: Attuned
references.note: So long as Attuned's other limitations are followed.

references.name: Essence Graft
references.note: So long as Essence Graft's other limitations are followed (e.g. only (m) Enchantments from its caster).

references.name: Phoenix Tears
references.note: So long as Phoenix Tears' other limitations are followed.

clarifications.text: Evolution works together with Attuned, Essence Graft or Phoenix Tears as long as the other limitations of those Enchantments are followed.

open_questions: Source mismatch: rules/magic-and-abilities/evolution.md says 'Available to: Scout 4' and Type Enchantment, but rules/classes/scout.md lists 'Evolution (T)' at 1st level and 'Granted as a Trait'; the packet shows both Scout 1st (ex) and Scout 4th. Duration recorded as permanent (Trait).
